C1513.title: VR Game Beat Saber Player Motion Data Can Uniquely Identify Real-World Identity
C1513.summary: Researchers at UC Berkeley analyzed over 2.5 million anonymized VR data records from more than 50,000 Beat Saber players and found that just 100 seconds of motion data could uniquely identify an individual with over 94% accuracy, while even 2 seconds of data could identify half of all users.
